arguments.content: P1 pattern: Removing legacy schema reads during a bounded background migration can break an entire list operation while ordinary new-write/read tests stay green. Verify the unchanged listing consumer with the supported persisted snapshot at zero migrations, after each relevant partial batch, and after completion/retry; a final migrated-state check alone misses the availability regression. In the destination reader cleanup, the HEAD reader listed all three fixture records at every state, while the staged nested-only reader raised KeyError('destination') before migration and after the first one-record batch. Retain the legacy read fallback until the compatibility contract permits removal.
